article.title: The Japanese food transition
article.excerpt: 1. Peak “buckwheat noodle” came in 1914. 2. Peak horse meat came in the 1960s. 3. Peak whale meat came in 2005-2006, although some of that supply was frozen and has not yet been consumed. 4. The consumption of vegetables has been broadly constant for decades. 5.
